Selected project / 03

Ping Express / PingBasket

The context.

A remittance product has to join the customer journey with exchange-rate logic, compliance handling, payout processing, and support operations. I led development planning and hands-on engineering across these workflows while strengthening how the team shipped and supported changes.

My contribution.

  1. Lead cross-functional development planning, technical task allocation, code review, milestone delivery, and production stabilization.
  2. Architect sender and receiver workflows, currency exchange logic, payout integrations, compliance handling, and transaction tracking.
  3. Build and support API layers consumed by web clients, mobile applications, and business partners.
  4. Improve operational tools for payment teams, including status visibility, reconciliation support, and investigation of failed transactions.
  5. Strengthen testing discipline, review practices, release checks, and hands-on mentoring.

The result.

  • Reduced post-production defects by 90% through stronger reviews, testing practices, and mentoring, as recorded in my professional résumé.
  • Built a foundation in connecting engineering quality to payment reliability.
Release discipline is a product capability when software is responsible for moving customers’ money.
